entries.message: Updated the about page to include a link to the 'Links' page.
Introduced a new 'Links' page with automated updates from Readwise.
Enhanced metadata structure for author information across multiple layouts.
Added microformats to improve semantic structure and metadata of layouts.
Updated changelog workflow to fetch full commit history for accurate logs.
Set timezone to IST in workflows and changelog for consistent timestamps.
Set timezone to Asia/Kolkata in workflows and changelog entries.
Updated changelog workflow and reduced displayed entries on the about page.
Updated system prompt, shortcode formatting, and CSS styles.
Ensure sequential execution of workflows to prevent conflicts.
Updated changelog workflow to pass data to the model.
Adjusted git log command for changelog generation.
Updated workflow permissions to include model read access.
